# Finobots

> An open-source AI financial operations agent for small businesses.

Finobots helps users manage invoices, payments, expenses, reconciliation, and cash flow through chat, with interactive tables, charts, and approvals.

## Product

- Live: https://finobots.vercel.app
- GitHub: https://github.com/opsenes-ai/finobots
- Issues: https://github.com/opsenes-ai/finobots/issues/new
- Discussions: https://github.com/opsenes-ai/finobots/discussions

## Features

- AI-powered chat interface for financial operations
- Invoice creation, tracking, and follow-up
- Payment monitoring with status updates
- Expense management and categorisation
- Cash flow insights and forecasting
- Account reconciliation
- Financial reporting and summaries
- Approval workflows for AI-proposed actions

## Integrations

- PayPal (available, sandbox support)
- Venmo (coming soon)

## Tech Stack

- Framework: Next.js 16 (App Router)
- Language: TypeScript
- UI: React 19, Tailwind CSS v4, shadcn/ui (base-nova)
- Icons: Lucide React
- Primitives: Base UI
- Backend: Supabase
- Deployment: Vercel

## Routes

- / — Home (landing page)
- /auth/login — Login
- /auth/signup — Sign up
- /auth/verify — Email verification
- /auth/forgot — Forgot password
- /auth/reset — Reset password
- /legal/terms — Terms of Service
- /legal/privacy — Privacy Policy
- /legal/cookies — Cookie Policy
- /console — Dashboard (redirects to /console/chat)
- /console/chat — New chat
- /console/chat/[chatId] — Chat session
- /console/accounts — Accounts overview
- /console/accounts/[accountId] — Account detail
- /console/cashflow — Cash flow
- /console/transaction — Transactions
- /console/transaction/[recordId] — Transaction detail
- /console/connections — Connections
- /console/connections/[connectionId] — Connection detail
- /console/recents — Recent chats
- /console/settings — Settings
